Online applications from 20/09/2026 to 20/10/2026.

| Driver Operator | Fire & Emergency Services | HSLC passed and valid HMV licence | Fire-service driving experience | 18 years | 25 years | 01/01/2026 | Rs. 14,000-60,500 plus Grade Pay Rs. 5,600 | Male height minimum 162.5 cm; PET race 3200 m in 14 minutes | Must be medically fit; colour blindness is disqualifying |

DOMICILE / RESIDENCY
Candidates must be permanent residents of Assam and registered with an Employment Exchange in Assam.

NATIONALITY
Candidate must be an Indian citizen.

AGE RELAXATION
| Category | Relaxation |
| --- | --- |
| SC / ST | 5 years |
| OBC / MOBC | 3 years |

APPLICATION FEE
Fee: No application fee
Exemptions: All applicants
Payment mode: Not applicable

HOW TO APPLY
1. Open https://slprbassam.in/apply.
2. Register or log in using the official recruitment portal.
3. Select the relevant Post and complete the application form.
4. Upload the documents listed in this Advertisement.
5. Submit the application before 20/10/2026.

DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
- Recent passport-size photograph
- Signature
- Age proof certificate
- Educational qualification certificates
- Caste certificate, where applicable
- Employment Exchange registration certificate
- Valid driving licence

SELECTION PROCESS
1. Physical Standard Test and document verification
2. Physical Efficiency Test
3. Driving skill test
4. Written examination
5. Medical examination

SCHEME OF EXAMINATION
| Phase | Subject | Questions | Marks | Duration |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Written examination | General Knowledge and Aptitude | 100 | 100 | 2 hours |

SYLLABUS
| Phase | Subject | Topics |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Written examination | General Knowledge and Aptitude | Assam history; current affairs; reasoning |

GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS
- Information supplied in the application must match the supporting certificates.
- Candidates must produce original documents during verification.
